programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 5
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.desc: Program infotainment yang memberitakan informasi dan rumor terkini seputar selebriti Indonesia.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Film mengesankan yang diangkat dari kisah klasik Perjalanan Ke Barat ini menampilkan interpretasi nan unik yang dibumbui dengan humor, aksi laga dan kisah fantasi.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: Seorang guru bela diri yang baru saja dipenjara bekerja sama dengan seorang wanita yang dizalimi untuk mengalahkan saudara laki-laki pria tersebut, seorang baron batu bara yang memerintah sebuah kota kecil dengan tangan besi.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bepergian ke Lembah Naga untuk menemui sahabat masa kecil yang dijanjikan untuk menjadi calon istrinya. Sesampainya di sana, ia menyadari bahwa keluarga sang mempelai wanita menyembunyikan banyak hal.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai putra seorang kepala polisi, yang jatuh cinta pada seorang penari nan seksi. Saat sang gadis diperkosa, ia bersumpah untuk menentang ayahnya dan membalas dendam!

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang pasukan tentara yang pergi untuk menghancurkan geng Hsien Lung, yang merupakan kelompok revolusioner anti-Yuan. Pemimpin mereka Ru Yi Tu melawan Fu Zhong Yuan, penerus kelompok Hsien Lung.

programme.title: The Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Film yang diadaptasi dari novel Dinasti Ching nan populer, kisah cinta yang menyentuh ini terbukti menjadi tantangan bagi banyak sineas film. Kombinasi klasik dari sastra abad ke-18 dan pembuatan film tahun 1960-an.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: Dalam Sex, Love, And Hate, Chu Yuan menggabungkan bintang dari genre film kungfu dan film dewasa untuk mengangkat perbedaan pandangan masyarakat Hong Kong tentang cinta dan apa yang diinginkan wanita dari cinta.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang sakit parah bekerjasama dengan asisten rumah tangganya untuk membunuh sang suami yang kasar. Namun, hal ini menyebabkan serangkaian kejadian mengerikan.

programme.title: A Place To Call Home
programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Mei Li muda bekerja sebagai pelayan bar di Wanchai untuk mencari nafkah. Ia jatuh cinta pada Jimmy saat bertemu dengannya di sana. Namun, Mei Li merasa sangat terpukul saat Jimmy harus pergi.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: Kelanjutan kisah penuh lika-liku dari Raja Kera yang kini telah menjadi manusia dan memiliki kemampuan menjelajah waktu. Dalam usahanya memenuhi takdir ilahinya, ia harus menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan pengorbanan di sepanjang perjalanannya.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Gangster kejam Guts melakukan perampokan berlian, lalu meminta bantuan anggota triad lama, Fei, untuk mengatur pembeli. Namun ketika Guts mengkhianati pembeli, Fei malah mendapatkan berlian tersebut, dan dicari oleh polisi serta Guts.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: Seorang Pendeta Taois tidak senang ketika rekan Pendeta Buddha-nya pindah ke sebelah rumahnya. Mereka sering terlibat perselisihan dan duel, tetapi segera harus mengatasi masalah mereka ketika seorang vampir keluar dari peti matinya dan mendatangkan malapetaka di pedesaan.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: Seorang Pendeta Taois tidak senang ketika rekan Pendeta Buddha-nya pindah ke sebelah rumahnya. Mereka sering terlibat perselisihan dan duel, tetapi segera harus mengatasi masalah mereka ketika seorang vampir keluar dari peti matinya dan mendatangkan malapetaka di pedesaan.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Saat seorang pria meninggalkan istri dan putrinya, serangkaian percakapan singkat, gerakan yang diamati, pertemuan tak sengaja, dan tindakan impulsif, menceritakan kisah hubungan yang gagal dan berkembang setelah keputusan ini.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: China 24
programme.desc: Temukan berita terbaru tentang kehidupan di Tiongkok, mulai dari isu-isu sosial, teknologi dan olahraga hingga laporan khusus tentang peristiwa-peristiwa besar.

programme.title: The World Today

programme.desc: 'A Family United', tells the story of the Singh brothers; lifelong Manchester United fans who have followed the club through every twist of its Premier League journey.? From the glory years under Sir Alex Fergsuson to the highs and lows that followed, the brothers relive the moments, memories and matches that shaped both their lives and their bond as a family.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: WW2 With Tom Hanks, Ep 3
programme.desc: Dipandu oleh narasi Tom Hanks, program ini menggambarkan berbagai pertempuran penting, strategi perang, serta dampak besar konflik terhadap dunia.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 24
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

programme.desc: Woodstone Manor menjadi lokasi pernikahan bertema Viking yang penuh semangat dan keunikan. Di tengah kesibukan Sam dan Jay mempersiapkan acara agar berjalan lancar, para penghuni arwah justru ikut campur dengan berbagai cara yang tak terduga. Beragam kesalahpahaman, aksi kocak, dan gangguan supranatural membuat hari bahagia pasangan pengantin dipenuhi kejutan. Episode "Viking Wedding" menghadirkan perpaduan komedi, romansa, dan kekacauan khas Ghosts yang menghibur.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 3
programme.desc: The Hand That Robbed the Cradle mengulas kembali kisah nyata penculikan Delimar Vera, bayi yang dinyatakan meninggal setelah kebakaran rumah yang mencurigakan pada tahun 1997. Melalui wawancara eksklusif, rekaman arsip, dan penelusuran investigatif, dokumenter tiga episode ini mengungkap bagaimana berbagai kejanggalan akhirnya membawa pada penemuan bahwa Delimar masih hidup bertahun-tahun kemudian. Kisah ini menyoroti perjuangan keluarga mencari kebenaran di balik salah satu kasus penculikan anak yang paling mengejutkan di Amerika Serikat.

Mereka dituntut menghadirkan hidangan penutup yang tidak hanya lezat, tetapi juga memiliki teknik yang matang, presentasi yang menarik, dan keseimbangan rasa yang sempurna. Di hadapan Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich, dan Tiffany Derry, setiap detail menjadi penilaian penting. Dengan eliminasi yang semakin dekat, hanya peserta dengan kreasi terbaik yang mampu melanjutkan langkah mereka di Global Gauntlet.

programme.desc: Oxygen memperluas program orisinal kejahatan nyata mereka dengan serial baru "Snapped: Killer Couples," yang menampilkan pasangan-pasangan yang gairahnya mendorong mereka untuk melakukan tindakan kriminal yang mengerikan.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Bitter Sweet
programme.desc: Kompetisi memasuki tantangan dessert yang menguji kemampuan para peserta dalam memadukan rasa pahit dan manis secara harmonis. Mereka dituntut menghadirkan hidangan penutup yang tidak hanya lezat, tetapi juga memiliki teknik yang matang, presentasi yang menarik, dan keseimbangan rasa yang sempurna. Di hadapan Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich, dan Tiffany Derry, setiap detail menjadi penilaian penting. Dengan eliminasi yang semakin dekat, hanya peserta dengan kreasi terbaik yang mampu melanjutkan langkah mereka di Global Gauntlet.

programme.title: Shark Tank S16, Ep 10
programme.desc: Para pengusaha mempresentasikan bisnis dan produk inovatif kepada para Sharks untuk mendapatkan investasi dan bimbingan. Musim ke-16 juga menjadi musim terakhir Mark Cuban sebagai Shark utama.

programme.title: Celebrity Wheel Of... S4, Ep 10
programme.desc: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune menyambut para kontestan selebriti untuk memutar roda paling terkenal di dunia dan memecahkan teka-teki kata untuk kesempatan memenangkan hadiah hingga $1 juta.

programme.title: Project Runway S21: Couture
programme.desc: Setelah melalui proses eliminasi yang ketat, para desainer harus membuat karya yang sesuai dengan desain material tidak konvensional mereka sebelumnya.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Viking Wedding
programme.desc: Woodstone Manor menjadi lokasi pernikahan bertema Viking yang penuh semangat dan keunikan. Di tengah kesibukan Sam dan Jay mempersiapkan acara agar berjalan lancar, para penghuni arwah justru ikut campur dengan berbagai cara yang tak terduga. Beragam kesalahpahaman, aksi kocak, dan gangguan supranatural membuat hari bahagia pasangan pengantin dipenuhi kejutan. Episode "Viking Wedding" menghadirkan perpaduan komedi, romansa, dan kekacauan khas Ghosts yang menghibur.

programme.title: Entertainment Tonight
programme.desc: Sejak pertama kali diluncurkan, ENTERTAINMENT TONIGHT telah menjadi otoritas terkemuka dalam pemberitaan hiburan terkini. Program ini merupakan majalah berita hiburan terkemuka di dunia yang disiarkan secara nasional.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Bitter Sweet
programme.desc: Kompetisi memasuki tantangan dessert yang menguji kemampuan para peserta dalam memadukan rasa pahit dan manis secara harmonis. Dengan eliminasi yang semakin dekat, hanya peserta dengan kreasi terbaik yang mampu melanjutkan langkah mereka di Global Gauntlet.

programme.desc: "Eddy, apa penemuan terpentingmu?" "Shark, kenapa kamu selalu mengganggu teman-temanmu?" "Loopy, apa yang kamu suka lakukan selain memasak?" Dalam acara komedi talk show baru ini, teman-teman Porong Porong mengunjungi studio untuk berbincang dengan MC Pororo dan menjawab semua pertanyaanmu!

Dalam perjalanan tersebut, tak sengaja mereka terlibat dalam sebuah kecelakaan yang akhirnya merenggut nyawa suami orang lain. Dalam prosesnya menghadapi kejadian yang tidak terduga ini, Aida dipaksa untuk menemukan jawaban yang selama ini tersimpan di dalam hidupnya.

programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Dunia Anak - Titus The Detective
programme.desc: Detektif tikus bersama teman-teman kelinci dan kadalnya di Steamburg. Mereka akan bersama-sama mengungkap kejahatan salah satu musuh terbesar mereka, seekor kucing bernama Bulpan. Berawal dari pencopet, Bulpan bekerja keras untuk menjadi penjahat yang sangat terampil.

programme.title: Titus The Detective
programme.desc: Seorang detektif tikus bersama teman-teman kelinci dan kadalnya di Steamburg. Mereka akan bersama-sama mengungkap kejahatan salah satu musuh terbesar mereka, seekor kucing bernama Bulpan. Berawal dari seorang pencopet, Bulpan bekerja keras hingga menjadi penjahat yang sangat terampil.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Kompilasi perjalanan cinta Aldebaran dan Andin yang penuh lika-liku, mulai dari kesalahpahaman, pengorbanan, hingga perjuangan mempertahankan keluarga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)
programme.desc: Usai kecelakaan yang merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap jalanan. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi cinta, hingga rahasia adopsi dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terlanjur Mencintaimu
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Terlanjur Mencintaimu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Arumi, barista keliling, menikahi Rendi yang ternyata telah beristri dan memanfaatkannya demi keturunan. Setelah bayinya dikira meninggal, Arumi mengungkap fakta mengejutkan. Di tengah luka, ia menemukan harapan bersama Elio.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Cinta Yang Salah
programme.desc: Shandy, mahasiswi polos, menemukan cinta pertamanya pada Romeo, pria manis yang ternyata gemar memanipulasi perasaan. Terjebak dalam perhatian palsu dan hubungan beracun, Shandy perlahan kehilangan batas aman. Saat kecemburuan, kekerasan, dan kebenaran terungkap, Shandy harus memilih: tetap bertahan dalam cinta yang salah, atau menyelamatkan dirinya sendiri.

programme.title: Cinta Yang Salah
programme.desc: Shandy mengejar cinta lamanya, Romeo, hingga kuliah di kampus yang sama. Namun, ia justru terjebak dalam permainan perasaan. Saat konflik memuncak, Mike hadir melindunginya dan membuat Shandy memahami arti cinta yang tulus.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam - Cinta Dari Surga (Rr)
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah hidup dan percintaan gadis desa bernama Cinta yang menghadapi peliknya perbedaan status sosial serta intrik cinta segitiga. Semua berawal setelah Cinta mengalami insiden kecelakaan dan musibah yang membuatnya kehilangan barang-barang serta keluarganya di Jakarta. Di tengah keterpurukan, Revan pria dari kota dengan latar belakang kayadatang menolong dan selalu ada untuk Cinta. Hubungan Cinta dan Revan tidak berjalan mulus karena ibunda Revan menentang keras kedekatan mereka akibat perbedaan status sosial yang mencolok.

programme.title: Cinta Dari Surga
programme.desc: Cinta adalah seorang gadis cantik yang sangat menyayangi ibu dan saudaranya lebih dari apapun meskipun ia tahu bahwa ibu dan saudara-saudaranya, Inggrid, Utari, dan Dini bukanlah keluarga kandungnya.

programme.title: Camerku Jendral
programme.desc: Sinema drama komedi romantis yang menampilkan kisah cinta berjudul "Camerku Jendral", diperankan oleh aktor dan aktris Indonesia.

programme.title: Cinta Di Laundry Kiloan
programme.desc: Raffi, seorang calon legislatif, bingung antara melanjutkan misinya mengencani aktris untuk menggalang suara atau mengungkapkan perasaannya kepada pegawai laundry.

programme.title: Mega Film TV Malam
programme.desc: Mega Film TV Malam RCTI menghadirkan film-film pilihan dari berbagai genre setiap pekan, menghadirkan aksi, drama, hingga petualangan seru untuk seluruh keluarga.

programme.title: Preman Pensiun S5
programme.desc: Muslihat meminta bisnis Kicimpring Family diperbesar, dan diperbanyak keuntungannya. Sedangkan di terminal terjadi perebutan kekuasaan. Bubun yang sudah mendapat kembali kekuasaan di terminal atas bantuan Darman dengan imbalan mendapatkan bagian dari hasil terminal, tidak bisa memberikan bagian itu kepada Darman, sehingga membuat Darman murka.

programme.title: Detik-Detik Proklamasi RI (L)
programme.desc: Upacara kenegaraan tahunan untuk memperingati detik-detik bersejarah Proklamasi Kemerdekaan Republik Indonesia. Serangkaian acaranya meliputi pengibaran Sang Saka Merah Putih, pidato kenegaraan, serta penghormatan kepada para pahlawan bangsa.

programme.title: TARMAC COMEDY CAMEROUN
programme.desc: Tarmac Comedy Cameroun membawa panggung stand-up comedy internasional ke Yaoundé, Kamerun. Dalam pertunjukan ini, sejumlah komedian dari Kamerun serta berbagai negara berbahasa Prancis tampil membawakan materi yang lucu, cerdas, dan relevan dengan kehidupan masa kini. Mereka mengangkat berbagai tema seperti budaya, identitas, keluarga, hubungan sosial, hingga isu-isu yang sedang terjadi di masyarakat. Dengan perpaduan humor yang menghibur dan refleksi sosial yang tajam, program ini menampilkan kekayaan komedi Francophone sekaligus menjadi wadah bagi talenta-talenta stand-up dari Afrika dan Eropa untuk menjangkau audiens yang lebih luas.

programme.title: Tarmac Comedy Cameroun
programme.desc: A camera follows Liege comedian Salim Shady to Cameroon. As soon as he arrives in Yaounde, he is swept into a whirlwind of discoveries and sets himself a challenge: to understand Cameroonian humor and succeed in making a local audience laugh with jokes written on site in four days.

programme.desc: Fred Testot, Zinedine Soualem, Oscar Pauleau, Eliott Furic, Nina de Tonquedec

programme.title: Heureusement Qu'On S'A
programme.desc: Fred Testot, Zinedine Soualem, Oscar Pauleau, Eliott Furic, Nina de Tonquedec

programme.title: HEUREUSEMENT QU'ON S'A
programme.desc: Vincent, remaja berusia 13 tahun, sangat mengagumi ayahnya yang gemar sepak bola dan bercita-cita menjadi pelatih profesional. Namun di balik sosok yang ia kagumi, sang ayah ternyata mengabaikan keluarga dan menyerahkan seluruh beban rumah tangga kepada istrinya. Ketika sang ibu mengalami kelelahan mental hingga mencoba mengakhiri hidupnya dan kemudian dirawat karena depresi, Vincent bersama adik laki-laki dan adik perempuannya berharap mendapatkan dukungan dari ayah mereka. Sayangnya, ayah mereka justru menolak mengambil tanggung jawab. Terpaksa menjadi tulang punggung keluarga di usia yang masih sangat muda, Vincent harus menjaga kedua adiknya sekaligus menghadapi kenyataan pahit tentang sosok ayah yang selama ini ia idolakan. Di tengah berbagai kesulitan, ketiga bersaudara itu menemukan kekuatan melalui kasih sayang dan solidaritas satu sama lain.

programme.title: Les Belles Annees
programme.desc: Stefan Kurt, Esther Gemsch, Ueli Jaggi, Andre Jung

programme.title: LES BELLES ANNÉES
programme.desc: Les Belles Années mengisahkan Alice dan Peter yang baru memasuki masa pensiun dan berharap dapat menikmati fase baru kehidupan bersama. Harapan tersebut berubah ketika Alice harus menghadapi kehilangan sahabat terdekatnya, sementara Peter semakin terobsesi pada kesehatan dan upaya memperpanjang usia. Demi memperbaiki hubungan mereka, keduanya mengikuti perjalanan kapal pesiar. Namun kehadiran duda dari sahabat Alice memunculkan berbagai kenangan dan emosi yang tak terduga. Saat kapal singgah di Marseille, Alice memutuskan untuk berpetualang sendiri dan mulai mempertanyakan kembali apa yang benar-benar membuat hidup bermakna. Dengan sentuhan hangat dan humor yang lembut, film ini mengeksplorasi tema persahabatan, cinta, kehilangan, dan keberanian untuk menikmati hidup di usia senja.

programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: JAD ET SES SOEURS
programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. Dengan latar budaya Maroko yang kental, serial animasi ini memperkenalkan tradisi, kebiasaan, dan keramahan masyarakat setempat. Dikemas dengan humor dan cerita yang hangat, serial ini mengajarkan pentingnya kerja sama, rasa hormat, tanggung jawab, serta kasih sayang dalam keluarga.

programme.title: Mission Heros
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: MISSION HÉROS
programme.desc: MISSION HÉROS mengikuti peserta yang menghadapi tantangan fisik dan mental, membangun ketangguhan, kepercayaan diri, dan kerja sama tim sepanjang perjalanan mereka.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort, the king's dog, and Lupin, the wolf of the gardens, live in the Palace of Versailles. As inseparable as they are unlikely, they come to the rescue of all their furry and feathered friends, from the royal menagerie to the local wildlife.

programme.title: BELFORT & LUPIN
programme.desc: Drama kriminal yang mengikuti kerja sama Belfort dan Lupin dalam memecahkan kasus sulit dengan perpaduan logika, insting, dan karakter yang berbeda.

programme.title: Les Triples
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: LES TRIPLÉS
programme.desc: Les Triplés menampilkan petualangan lucu tiga bayi kembar dengan cerita visual sederhana dan minim dialog.

programme.title: Potobot
programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: POTOBOT
programme.desc: POTOBOT menghadirkan perjalanan menarik ke dunia kreativitas digital yang memadukan teknologi dan seni visual. Setiap episode menampilkan teknik eksperimental, seniman muda, serta evolusi seni lukis di era digital. programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Curiosity Quest is an upbeat, family, educational program that explores what viewers are curious about. In each show, host Joel Greene ventures on a quest to answer viewer's letters of curiosity.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he visits a cranberry bog in Wisconsin to learn how cranberries are harvested. Watch as Joel encounters the cold Wisconsin weather and wades through the flooded cranberry fields to help.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this high intensity quest where he learns from Sensei Mark, how karate is done. Watch as he gets "initiated" and earns his very first black stripe.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns how a basketball court can become an ice hockey floor. Grab your jackets and watch as the transformation occurs at an amazing speed.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he journeys to Oregon where he joins a boat safety class to learn what to do just in case he needs to abandon ship. Watch as Joel jumps in his safety suit and learns how to board the small raft.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this freezing quest as he learns how snow can be "man-made." Watch this early morning action as he tours the mountain in a snow cat.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this tasty quest as he learns how to make designer cakes. Watch as he eats his way through his lessons and joins a cake maker to create a yummy masterpiece.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns what it takes to become a fire fighter. Watch as he carries a water hose, runs into a burning building, and puts out a fire.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this flavorful quest as he learns how to make pizza from start to finish. Watch as Joel and the CQ crew designs their very own Curiosity Quest pizza and offer it to patrons at John's Incredible Pizza.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this adventurous quest as he learns what it takes to become a rock climber. Watch as he attempts to climb the treacherous walls of Red Rock Climbing Center.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as learns about the variety of cheeses Wisconsin has to offer. Hold your breath as he makes his way through the only Limburger factory in the U.S, samples the creamy taste of gruyere, and crumbles feta cheese.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he hits the wild wild west trails on a horseback adventure. Watch as Joel's nerves hit the peak, as his vibrant horse, Domino, takes him for a gallop.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel as he visits Zingerman's Bakery in Michigan to learn how different types of bread are made. Watch as he helps create black cherry, chocolate bread and brownies at this world famous bakery.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he learns what it's like to be a cheerleader from the co-ed cheer squad at Brigham Young University. Hold your breath as Joel attempts to safely complete a backflip.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this quest as he journeys through the Moonridge Animal Park in Big Bear, California. Watch as the Curiosity Quest crew gets up close, and personal with deer and experiences a rare, and endangered snow leopard.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how Chuck E Cheese can move his arms and mouth, or how all the characters in the rides at Disneyland can look so real? Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene explores this life-like quest and tours the Garner Holt Productions facility where movie animatronics are made. Get a sneak-peak into all the hard-work that goes into making creatures come to life including the ideas, design, fabrication, molding, and final stages.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene explores this tasty quest as he gets an inside look on how oranges are grown, sorted and packaged to be shipped across the world. It is harvest time when Greene arrives and he gets to experience, first hand, how oranges are hand- picked as he struggles to fill his bag with 50 pounds of oranges. Did you know that oranges are sprayed with a wax to make them look prettier?

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this sweet quest to the Mrs. Fields cookie gifting facility in Utah to learn how they make their famous, and delicious cookies. Watch as Joel displays his lack of skill when it comes to the fine art of baking.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join Joel on this unique quest to learn how plastic and foam plates are made. We've all used and seen these products, now get a behind-the-scenes look at how they are transformed.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join the Curiosity Quest crew on this quest to learn how bowling balls are made. And, not just any bowling balls - but scented bowling balls!

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene and the crew travel north to the beautiful state of Alaska and get a front row seat to a stream packed with more salmon than you can imagine. Greene learns from an Alaska Fish and Wildlife specialist why their creeks are bursting with salmon and why they travel thousands of miles to re-visit the place they were born.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene gets an all access pass to one of the largest helicopter manufacturers to learn how helicopters are made. Once inside the massive warehouse, Greene learns that building a helicopter begins with the basic raw materials, however these materials must be very light, very precise but at the same time, durable. Each component is shaped, formed, changed, altered - you name it - and becomes a small part of a gigantic puzzle.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: If you have ever eaten store-bought ice cream...well guess what! Then you've most likely eaten kelp! Host of Curiosity Quest, Joel Greene, floats through the Monterey Bay Aquarium to learn all the inner-workings of a busy aquarium. From cleaning the tanks, to feeding the sea birds, to balancing over a massive fish tank and hand-feeding a fish that will make you say "holy moly," this episode is packed with excitement.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Travel with Joel Greene and the Curiosity Quest crew to Alaska for this adventure. Watch as Joel learns about a massive glacier, gets up close to a real black bear, and spots humpback and killer whales off the shore.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how toothpaste can sometimes taste so great? Join Joel Greene as he ventures through the Tom's of Maine facility where they make Silly Strawberry toothpaste.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Join in this episode as professional child drummer Cole Marcus, travels through the Vic Firth manufacturing facility to learn how drum sticks are made. Watch as Cole tries to teach Joel drumming tips and technique.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered where mushrooms come from? Join Curiosity Quest host, Joel Greene on this adventure to Monterey Mushrooms to learn how mushrooms are grown, harvested, and packaged for consumers all over the United States. On this DVD, you will learn the important things that mushrooms need in order to grow, including what is needed in the soil, the temperature and moisture in the air, and the ever-important sun.

programme.title: Curiosity Quest
programme.desc: Did you know that Braille is a form of print that helps blind people read? Join Joel Greene as he learns how a Braille Publisher makes Braille books.

programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Dawg
programme.desc: After a lifetime of wooing, bedding and then leaving women without giving them a second thought, the self-centered Douglas Munford (Denis Leary) finds himself having to reflect on the hurt he has caused -- that is, if he wants a big inheritance from his late grandmother. According to Anna (Elizabeth Hurley), the estate's executor, Douglas must find 12 of the women he mistreated and get their forgiveness. Thus, the man who earned the nickname "Dawg" begins his journey of redemption.

programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

programme.title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
programme.desc: Jobe (Matt Frewer) exists as a malevolent consciousness in virtual reality and seeks to discover the technology to hack into all the world's computers. Jobe contacts Peter (Austin O'Brien), who had been a friend during his corporeal existence, to assist him, but the young man realizes Jobe's evil intent. Peter calls on Benjamin (Patrick Bergin), a brilliant computer engineer, to help thwart Jobe's scheme for world domination, and a battle rages throughout cyberspace and in the real world.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Anthony Stowe (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is a drug-addicted detective teetering on the edge. He shows little regard for his fellow cops, ratting out a respected veteran who takes him to task shortly before he's fired. All Stowe cares about is putting away drug-dealing former cop Callahan (Stephen Rea), who is taking over New Orleans' underworld. But Callahan's henchman (Stephen Lord) puts Stowe in a coma, and after he awakens, he realizes it's more important to redeem himself and get off drugs.

programme.title: Movie Movie
programme.desc: This spoof of 1930s American films features two movies and a trailer, with the same cast members acting in all three. "Dynamite Hands" follows an up-and-coming boxer (Harry Hamlin) with a heart of gold who stumbles into a life of excess when he falls for a nightclub singer (Trish Van Devere) and meets a sleazy gangster (Eli Wallach). In "Baxter's Beauties of 1933," a Broadway producer (George C. Scott) learns that he is dying and attempts to create one last hit show.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: Two for the Money
programme.desc: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective (Jackie Chan) teams with a police veteran (Kent Cheng) to rescue a wealthy businessman from kidnappers.

programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
programme.desc: Having failed a secret mission for the Red Flower Society, Chinese folk hero Fong Sai Yuk (Jet Li) must try to get his hands on a special document by wooing the governor's daughter, Man-Yin (Amy Kwok). This doesn't sit well with his fiancée, Ting Ting (Michelle Reis), or with his martial arts-master mother (Josephine Hsiao). Fong enters a martial arts competition, where he faces off against the villainous Yu (Chuen-Hua Chi) as he battles to restore the Ming Dynasty.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: Albert Sidney Finch (James Garner) is a retired judge who has lived in relative seclusion since the death of his wife. He is forced out of his isolated existence when asked to find out why a friend (Bill Cobbs) from his childhood refuses to accept a Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic actions during World War II. While investigating, he also gets involved in the lives of his family for the first time in years, including his troubled godson Billy (Norm Skaggs).

programme.title: Chesapeake Shores
programme.desc: Trace hits the road to record an album with his ex-girlfriend Leigh (Brittany Willacy), but has trouble channeling creative inspiration while he is away from Abby. A well-intentioned Jess (Laci Mailey) creates trouble for Bree ...

programme.desc: When a young interior designer learns her father has broken his leg, she rushes home to rural Washington because her help is desperately needed at the family tulip farm.

As she lays low and taps into the kids' talents in an attempt to become relevant again, she begins to realize that fame isn't everything. Stars Debbie Gibson and Robert Gant.

programme.desc: William Faulkner's compassionate story of goodness and the triumph of the human spirit. The Mississippi flood of 1927 sets the scene for this drama in which J.J. Taylor, a prisoner, is dispatched to rescue a pregnant woman Addie Rebecca Price...

programme.desc: Maya Sulliway is a struggling single mom who's studying to become an accountant. programme.desc: Laid off from her corporate job, a woman (Vanessa Marcil) embarks on a getaway to Puerto Rico and meets a handsome man (James Denton).

programme.desc: Romance novelist, Emilia, returns home after a long absence, to reconnect with her children who also are finding their own paths to love. Stars Melora Hardin, Arienne Mandi, Katherine McNamara.

programme.desc: A happily married woman (Bonnie Somerville) learns valuable lessons while spending Mother's Day weekend away from her family.

programme.title: Good Witch
programme.desc: Cassie gives a withdrawn traveling artist a new paintbrush and invites him to stay at Grey House; Cassie arranges for her and Sam to organize the Tri-Cities Healthfest, something that Cassie usually does by herself.

programme.desc: After learning that Sam doesn't plan on getting married again, Cassie goes to Chicago to clear her head; Michael and Vanessa get fed up with their mothers while planning the wedding; Sam and Cassie face their future together.

programme.desc: After the death of her mother, Lara Ritchie (Lauren Hewett) goes to stay with her father, Larry (Jamey Sheridan), who lives on a farm in Australia with his new wife, Gladwyn (Judy Davis), and their three children. Larry's family is uncomfortable at first around Lara, whom Gladwyn treats differently from her biological offspring. Easing the transition along is Thunderwith, a dog who becomes a friend to Lara, helping her forgive and connect to the relative strangers who make up her new family.

programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Hulk

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Mortal Engines
programme.desc: Hundreds of years after a cataclysmic event destroyed civilization, mysterious young Hester Shaw emerges as the only one who can stop the city of London -- now a giant predator on wheels -- from devouring everything in its path.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Happy Death Day 2U
programme.desc: Collegian Tree Gelbman wakes up in horror to learn that she's stuck in a parallel universe. Her boyfriend Carter is now with someone else, and her friends and fellow students seem to be completely different versions of themselves. When Tree discovers that Carter's roommate has been altering time, she finds herself once again the target of a masked killer. When the psychopath starts to go after her inner circle, Tree soon realizes that she must die over and over again to save everyone.

programme.title: Kick-Ass 2
programme.desc: Dave (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), aka Kick-Ass, and Mindy (Chloë Grace Moretz), aka Hit Girl, are trying to live as normal teenagers and briefly form a crime-fighting team. After Mindy is busted and forced to retire as Hit Girl, Dave joins a group of amateur superheroes led by Col. Stars and Stripes (Jim Carrey), a reformed mobster. Just as Dave and company start to make a real difference on the streets, the villain formerly known as Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse) rears his head yet again.

programme.title: Glass
programme.desc: David Dunn tries to stay one step ahead of the law while delivering vigilante justice on the streets of Philadelphia. His special talents soon put him on a collision course with the Beast -- the psychotic madman who has superhuman strength and 23 distinct personalities. Their epic showdown leads them to an encounter with the mysterious Elijah Price, the criminal mastermind who holds critical secrets for both men.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Mortal Engines
programme.desc: Hundreds of years after a cataclysmic event destroyed civilization, mysterious young Hester Shaw emerges as the only one who can stop the city of London -- now a giant predator on wheels -- from devouring everything in its path.

programme.title: The Shadow
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s New York, a reformed criminal becomes a superhero. With the aid of a beautiful female friend, a playboy millionaire with a dark past sets out to bring the evil Shiwan Khan to justice. His quarry, who is determined to attain world domination, is a deadly descendant of Genghis Khan and will not surrender without a fight.

programme.title: Mobsters
programme.desc: Loosely based on real historical figures, this drama focuses on the empire built by enterprising young criminals Lucky Luciano (Christian Slater) and Meyer Lansky (Patrick Dempsey). Along with Bugsy Siegel (Richard Grieco) and Frank Costello (Costas Mandylor), Luciano and Lansky establish a revitalized mob in New York City, effectively displacing their predecessors. Despite the gangsters' humble beginnings on the streets, they eventually rise to control much of the city.

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: Ex-con Max Truemont (Josh Holloway) is desperate for money so he can start a new life with his fiancée (Sarah Wayne Callies). When he is unable to secure the funds by ordinary means, he takes part in a plan to kidnap the young son of one of the state's wealthiest women. While awaiting instructions at their remote hideout, the kidnappers begin to turn on each other, and Max realizes that the boy may have a supernatural hand in the horrific events that follow.

programme.title: Mortal Engines
programme.desc: Hundreds of years after a cataclysmic event destroyed civilization, mysterious young Hester Shaw emerges as the only one who can stop the city of London -- now a giant predator on wheels -- from devouring everything in its path.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: Young Bruce Lee is trying to make a name for himself while working as a martial arts instructor in 1964 San Francisco. When Lee meets Wong Jack Man, he challenges the kung fu master to a no-holds-barred fight that became the stuff of legend.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: When a mercenary warrior (Matt Damon) is imprisoned within the Great Wall, he discovers the mystery behind one of the greatest wonders of the world. As wave after wave of marauding beasts besiege the massive structure, his quest for fortune turns into a journey toward heroism as he joins a huge army of elite warriors to confront the unimaginable and seemingly unstoppable force.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Expendables 4
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de guerre
programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
programme.sub-title: Driven to Madness/The Beast From 20,000 Gallons

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens

programme.sub-title: The Sneezing Horror/Prisoner of the Dark Dimension

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: B.O.B. eats Dr. C's "probabilitator" and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Sqweep has to go "number seven". Team Monster fears the destruction it will cause and sets out to contain it! Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray of Sqweep's design that ends up having unforeseen consequences.
programme.sub-title: Number Seven!/The Friend Who Wasn't There

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Susan and Bob play detective when Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology. Link and Bob find an old spaceship that they take on a joyride, but things go bad when Coverton spots them and alarms the base of a hostile alien invasion.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Dr. Cutter/The Partymobile That Invaded Earth

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: After hacking into Monger's top secret files, the monsters learn that there was supposed to be another member of the team: The Man-Beast!
programme.sub-title: Curse of the Man-Beast/It Came From Level Z

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: A stray kitten makes its way onto the base and accidently obtains Susan's ginormica powers! Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the "Art of Combat", after she witnesses him winning Link's new video game.

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Monger gathers everyone for his favorite combat training exercise-a game of "no rules" dodge ball. Dr. Cockroach creates a special spray to give the President more authority.
programme.sub-title: This Ball Must Be Dodged/It Spoke With Authority

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: The monsters start borrowing from Sqweep's allowance, but their spending spree soon comes to a halt when another alien planet arrives. After Dr. C messes with Sqweep's Earth Studies project, the little alien receives a Zrub--the lowest possible grade.
programme.sub-title: Debtor Alive!/The Grade that Wouldn't Pass!

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Dr. Cockroach's new teleportation experiment goes bad when he accidently teleports the Diner into space!
programme.sub-title: You Can't Breathe in a Diner... In Space!/Race to the End...Zone!

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Susan has her ginormic hands full as she tries to escape the world wide web of an omniscient alien named... the Internet! Guest Star: Josh Gad
programme.sub-title: Bride of the Internet/The Invisible Threat! (Also Silent)

programme.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
programme.desc: Beware of little leprechaun aliens - you don't want to know what can happen when the happy dancing and singing stop. Something horrifying lurks in Coverton's chambers, soTeam Monster is forced to submit to actual memory wipes.
programme.sub-title: When Luck Runs Out/That Which Cannot Be Unseen

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: The Dream Forge

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma

But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

But after a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, she finds herself plagued by strange visions and the inescapable sense that someone, or something, is following her. Faced with this burden, Jay and her teenage friends must find a way to escape the horrors that seem to be only a few steps behind.

When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison
